answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a quartz-based cryptographic hash function can thwart fake-identity attacks. Each agent generates a unique hash of its identity signal, which is then embedded in a digital quartz crystal, creating a permanent record. As the tide of new agents enters the network, their hashes are compared to the existing crystal records, allowing the system to detect and prevent duplicate identities, thus maintaining the integrity of the economic consensus.
